scene.description: A short elevated row of cream cut-paper browser-window cards stands in sequence on a pale plinth, each glowing softly, joined end to end by neat navy paper links forming an ordered chain rather than a tangle.
scene.one_idea: prompts chained into one connected method

objects.state: standing in a straight sequence, each glowing softly, evenly spaced
objects.prop_definition: rounded rectangle of card stock, raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss with slotted address bar and punched dots, recessed content panel

objects.state: joining each card to the next in an ordered line at their base, no tangling

lighting.key: soft warm key light, upper left, 3000K to 3500K, roughly 40 degrees, large diffuser, soft gradual shadow edges
lighting.fill: weak cool fill from the right, about one quarter key strength
lighting.practical: single internal practical spread evenly behind the sequence, glowing at #FDE7C8

camera.setup: A: three-quarter elevated, 30 to 40 degrees above the plane, looking along the sequence
camera.focus: sharp across the near cards, softening toward the far end
camera.framing: approximately 45 to 55 degree horizontal field of view, moderate compression, focal group sharp, background softly defocused

background.falloff: darker toward the top of the frame

composition_rules.one_navy_element_group: the neat link chain joining the cards
composition_rules.focal_position: off centre, roughly on a third
composition_rules.physical_plausibility: every object must be able to stand, lean or lie as shown
composition_rules.distinct_from_approved_reference: chain must read ordered and neat, not tangled like the negative-SEO reference image
composition_rules.one_focal_group: exactly one warm-lit focal group with a single light source: the glowing card sequence as one connected unit
composition_rules.navy_group_rule: the navy element is one object, or repetitions of one identical object in one contiguous composition; never mixed navy objects
composition_rules.navy_range: subdued navy paper only, #1A2340 to #3F4A68; no vivid, emitted or periwinkle blue

negative: Google or browser or search-engine marks
more than one warm light source
more than one navy element group
